exceptions.reason: Browser-support data that Next.js reads through browserslist at build time to pick compile targets; it is not code and is not bundled into the export. CC-BY-4.0 asks only for attribution, which third-party-licenses.txt gives, and carries no non-commercial or share-alike term.

Mozilla's root certificates as data, in the Cargo graph only as a wasm32-target dependency of rustls-platform-verifier, so no desktop build links it. CDLA-Permissive-2.0 is a permissive data license whose one condition, that its text travel with the data, third-party-licenses.txt meets.

A dependency of markdown-it's command-line entry, which the MCP server never imports, so the sidecar bundle leaves it out. PSF-2.0 is the Python Software Foundation part of the allowed Python-2.0 license: permissive, asking only that the license text travel with the code, which third-party-licenses.txt does.

A required dependency of notify 9, the file watcher behind the vault watch and the Work status file pulse; notify uses it only for PollWatcher's content comparison, and the app builds no PollWatcher. notify 9 is the first release whose macOS callback catches panics instead of aborting the app or unwinding through macOS's run loop. BSL-1.0 is permissive, with no copyleft or field-of-use term, and asks only that its text travel with source copies, exempting machine code; third-party-licenses.txt carries it anyway.
